text:
infra-bot: [ALERT] apiserver 5xx spike in us-west1 starting ~09:02 UTC; spike ~80/min affecting proxy path :rotating_light:
lina: seeing attach RPC timeouts from gpu-provisioner; provisioner logs showing repeated dial timeouts and requeues :confused:
```
W0402 09:01:58.120 attach_client.go:88] dial timeout to attach-service: i/o timeout
E0402 09:02:01.450 provisioner.go:412] attach failed for pod redwood/trainer-7: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = unexpected EOF
I0402 09:02:03.000 provisioner.go:420] requeue node gpu-pool-7 retry=4
```
owen: cloud reported SNAT exhaustion on the NAT gateway from 08:59-09:05; they claim ports freed at 09:06. this maps to our attach failures.
daria: metric `attach_controller_workqueue_depth` jumped 6->260 between 08:58-09:04; apiserver p95 request latency up to 8s. leader election churn observed once at 09:04.
lina: mitigation: pause canary HPA, cordon nodes that are mid-attach, and run a small requeue job to avoid hammering attach-service.
owen: doing HPA scale now: `kubectl scale deploy/gpu-trainer-canary -n redwood --replicas=1`
infra-bot: action logged: HPA scale by owen at 09:07
daria: follow-up: propose prewarmed GPU nodes with attached devices for high-onboard windows, and route attach calls via internal LB to avoid NAT. cost estimate and runbook change needed.
lina: created temporary alert `gpu_attach_latency_high` -> page oncall if p95 > 5s for 10m. will monitor and update in 20m. :thumbsup:
